suite.business_outcome: Move a consultant from discovery and readiness through company and job decisions, submission, interview learning and operational support while preserving ownership at every handoff.

applications.name: MAAS
applications.business_role: Operational system for companies, consultant profiles, jobs, submissions, interviews, reports and automation.
applications.ownership_boundary: Owns the operational consultant workflow and remains the source of truth for shared records that intelligence applications currently map during transition.

applications.name: MTAS
applications.business_role: Candidate lead discovery, intake compliance, role mapping, outreach and program-fit decisions.
applications.ownership_boundary: Owns candidate intake and lead qualification before readiness and market workflows consume the result.

applications.name: MTLS
applications.business_role: Training and marketing readiness through playbooks, lab evidence, mock interviews, scoring and trainer review.
applications.ownership_boundary: Owns training proof and readiness evidence; MAAS owns market positioning and placement learning.

applications.name: MCIS
applications.business_role: Company intelligence and sponsorship-fit decisions for consultant placement.
applications.ownership_boundary: Owns company-level Apply or Do Not Apply guidance; operational job, submission and interview records remain MAAS-owned during transition.

applications.name: MJIS
applications.business_role: Job intelligence, ATS intake review, source health and job approval or rejection.
applications.ownership_boundary: Owns job-intelligence decisions; company policy remains in MCIS and operational submission and interview lifecycles remain downstream.

applications.name: MSIS
applications.business_role: Submission lifecycle intelligence, readiness visibility, rejection analysis, hires and evidence quality.
applications.ownership_boundary: Owns submission intelligence and reporting views while MAAS remains the operational submission source during transition.

applications.name: MIIS
applications.business_role: Interview schedule and round visibility, feedback capture, preparation gaps and reusable interview learning.
applications.ownership_boundary: Owns interview intelligence and feedback visibility; MAAS remains the operational interview source during transition and MTLS consumes readiness feedback.

applications.name: MCSS
applications.business_role: Support issue intake, tracking and callback service for suite operations.
applications.ownership_boundary: Owns support issue lifecycle; only integrations evidenced in source may be documented as active relationships.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: A qualified candidate enters training or readiness work.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Candidate identity, intake compliance, role mapping and readiness need.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: Do not represent a candidate as training-ready when intake identity or compliance context is incomplete.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: Reviewed training proof becomes input to market positioning.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Readiness status, approved evidence, skill or role context and trainer decision.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: Draft or unreviewed training content must not become official market evidence.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: A company is considered suitable before its jobs are prioritized.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Company identity, placement decision, sponsorship evidence, confidence and review status.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: A Do Not Apply or unresolved company decision prevents the job path from being treated as suitable.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: A reviewed job becomes eligible for the consultant workflow.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Canonical job identity, source provenance, approval state, classification and audit tags.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: Rejected, stale or untraceable jobs remain outside the operational submission path.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: Operational submission activity becomes visible for coaching and outcome analysis.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Shared MAAS submission records currently mapped read-only by MSIS during transition.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: MSIS must not claim operational ownership or mutate workflow outside its explicitly documented boundary.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: Operational interview activity becomes visible for feedback and preparation analysis.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Shared MAAS interview records currently mapped read-only by MIIS during transition.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: MIIS must preserve MAAS record authority until workflow ownership is explicitly transferred.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: Interview outcomes reveal the next training or preparation gap.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Round outcome, questions, feedback, preparation gaps and follow-up context.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: Missing or ambiguous interview evidence cannot silently lower or raise readiness.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: An operational MAAS problem is raised into the support lifecycle.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Source context and issue payload through the repository-evidenced MCSS client.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: A failed issue handoff remains visible in MAAS and must not be reported as a created support issue.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: A candidate-intake problem is tracked and its status returns to MTAS.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Issue creation plus signed callback endpoints evidenced in MTAS source.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: Invalid callback authentication or an unknown issue state must fail closed without changing the lead record.

relationship_contracts.business_moment: A submission-intelligence problem is tracked and its status returns to MSIS.
relationship_contracts.known_contract: Issue creation plus signed callback endpoints evidenced in MSIS source.
relationship_contracts.failure_promise: Invalid callback authentication or an unknown issue state must fail closed without changing submission intelligence.

discovery_gaps: Named accountable and operational owner for each application
Canonical API, event or shared-data schema and version for every relationship
Data classification and minimum-necessary field set per handoff
Identity, authorization, consent and secret-rotation owner per interface
Timeout, retry, idempotency, reconciliation and degraded-user behavior
Verified current runtime, environment, release and recovery evidence
Detailed architecture page and application-specific SVG for each repository
